datasets.title: Bitcoin blocks
datasets.what: Transactions and outputs of every block in the window, with each block header checked.

datasets.title: Bitcoin chain statistics
datasets.what: Fees, fee rates, size, supply and script use per block, from the blocks alone.

datasets.title: Company flows
datasets.what: What each exchange or fund sent and received per block.
datasets.source: Bitcoin blocks and the company label set

datasets.title: Who mined the blocks
datasets.what: Blocks per mining pool, from coinbase payouts and tags.
datasets.source: Bitcoin blocks and the bitcoin-data/mining-pools list
datasets.rights: Pool list under the MIT licence

datasets.title: Ethereum chain statistics
datasets.what: Gas, base fee and transactions per block, each block checked against its hash.

datasets.title: U.S. total public debt
datasets.what: Treasury "Debt to the Penny", read by observers drawn at random who seal their answers.

datasets.title: Earthquakes per day
datasets.what: How many earthquakes of magnitude 5.0 or more the USGS catalog lists worldwide on a day, read 100 days later.
datasets.rights: Facts from a U.S. public-domain catalog

datasets.title: Daily high temperature, Denver
datasets.what: The highest temperature NOAA recorded at Denver International Airport on a day, read 30 days later.

datasets.title: U.S. Treasury cash balance
datasets.what: The Treasury General Account closing balance from the Daily Treasury Statement, in millions of dollars.

datasets.title: Daily high temperature, New York
datasets.what: The highest temperature NOAA recorded in Central Park, New York, on a day, read 30 days later.

datasets.title: Daily rain, New York
datasets.what: The rain NOAA recorded in Central Park, New York, on a day, read 30 days later.

datasets.title: Daily rain, Denver
datasets.what: The rain NOAA recorded at Denver International Airport on a day, read 30 days later.

datasets.title: U.S. Treasury daily deposits
datasets.what: The total deposits into the Treasury General Account on a day, from the Daily Treasury Statement, in millions of dollars.

datasets.title: Earthquakes near Los Angeles
datasets.what: How many earthquakes of magnitude 2.5 or more the USGS catalog lists within 300 km of Los Angeles on a day, read 100 days later.
datasets.rights: Facts from a U.S. public-domain catalog

datasets.title: Crypto-asset units in SEC filings
datasets.what: The crypto-asset units a company tagged in its SEC filing for a period.

datasets.title: Spot bitcoin ETF holdings
datasets.what: The bitcoin each U.S. spot fund tagged in a 10-Q or 10-K.

datasets.title: Company reserves
datasets.what: Each company's bitcoin at its own published addresses, cross-checked block by block.
datasets.source: Issuer address lists and Bitcoin blocks
